notes: Identity verified from supplied transcription: article title Measuring Global Oral Proficiency in SLA Research: A New Elicited Imitation Test of L2 Chinese; Shu-Ling Wu and Lourdes Ortega; Foreign Language Annals 46(4), 680–704, 2013; DOI 10.1111/flan.12063 on PDF page 1. Cache is a Scribd-hosted, page-labelled transcription of the primary article, including methods, results, discussion, references and appendices across 25 pages, rather than an abstract or secondary report. OCR/callback formatting retained in evidence. No source PDF was supplied; layout could not be independently rendered. The description covers item length and syntactic complexity, but the cited section contains one formal correlation for length, with r = -0.86 and p = 0.000, and r squared = 0.74 as a separately printed variance measure. Preserve requested printed r; no effect conversion. The legacy glyph preceding 0.86 is supported as a negative sign by the literal narrative negative correlation. Subsequent syntactic-complexity evidence compares Items 11 and 12 (both 13 syllables; means 1.47 and 2.22 across pages 14–15) and gives no separate coefficient or p. Those examples are not treated as the same test. N is unassigned and left as a placeholder; participant contributor count is not assumed to be the item-correlation observation count. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders.
